description: Read idle-pool opt-in, the latest workload status and credited USDC for this host's machines, or for owner_account_id when that owner delegated earnings:read. The credit is already in the host balance and withdraws the same way. Read-only. 404 while the idle pool is off.

owner_account_id.description: Owner account id when this key manages that owner's fleet. Omit to act as the key's own account.
